stories.headline: Anthropic announces Claude IPO roadshow with proposed $70–$78 share price
stories.summary: Anthropic outlines a proposed 825-million-share offering at a $70–$78 indicative range with planned Nasdaq ticker ANT; the registration is not yet effective.

stories.headline: Italy fines Meta €805m over access to users' photos
stories.summary: Italy's data protection authority fined Meta €805 million, saying the Facebook Android app accessed users' photos without specific consent; about 20 million users were not informed.

stories.headline: Microsoft files patent for AI that can alter what people say during a live broadcast
stories.source: Israel First TV Program, via Futurism
stories.summary: The patent describes near-real-time AI that changes a speaker's words on live video and moves their lips to match; filed April 2025, published Oct 29, 2026.

stories.headline: GTA 6 has gone gold: development complete
stories.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told investors Nov 9 that Rockstar has completed development of GTA VI, ten days before the Nov 19 launch.

stories.headline: GTA VI pre-load breaks UK broadband records before launch
stories.summary: Virgin Media O2 carried more data on pre-load Tuesday than on any entire day before it; Openreach traffic ran 32.9% above a normal Tuesday.

stories.headline: Zelensky says US proposed Ukraine leave Donbas for NATO membership
stories.summary: Zelensky said US negotiators at the Abu Dhabi talks proposed, for the first time, that Ukraine withdraw from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership; the US has not confirmed the proposal.

stories.headline: Trilateral talks resume in Abu Dhabi following initial agreement on prisoner exchange
stories.summary: Ukraine, Russia and US talks continue in Abu Dhabi, building on preliminary progress toward a new prisoner-of-war exchange.

stories.headline: All 8 Harry Potter movies are officially disappearing ahead of HBO's reboot
stories.summary: All eight films — plus the three Fantastic Beasts spin-offs — leave Peacock on December 1, days before HBO's reboot series premieres on Christmas Day.
